camera: Premier League tactical camera: one fixed position on the main stand that pans/tilts/zooms to follow play. No replays or close-ups in the first half.

clock_sync.method: Scoreboard seconds digit ticks on frames = 9 (mod 25) at f2709 (01:15), f30009 and f60009 -> no dropped frames; f71434 shows 47:04 = 2824 s, exactly Opta's end-of-first-half timestamp.

first_half.note: Kickoff is frame 834, but frames 834-1150 (first 12.7 s) are on the wide stadium camera under intro graphics; analysis starts when the tactical camera is clean. No substitutions in the first half (first sub: Mahrez for Sterling, 68').

kits.note: Kit colour classes used by tools/track_identities.py (rules in KIT_RULES there). Verified on crops: City sky-blue/white, Spurs white/navy, Ederson all-green (his torso reads as grass to the colour features), Lloris orange, officials black. Kulusevski's goal (03:56) is in the left goal, Gundogan's (32:48) in the right: City attack left-to-right in the first half.
